headline: Best Buy chairman emeritus Richard Schulze sells $27.8 million in company stock
summary: Richard Schulze, founder and chairman emeritus of consumer electronics retailer Best Buy, sold $27.8 million worth of shares.
why: Large insider share sales at major US retailers are monitored by equity investors for signals on executive sentiment and portfolio realignment.
